sources.note: Nothing on stress. States the whole Tonocoté corpus is 'una oración muy breve, de solo tres palabras' recorded by Alonso de Bárzana, published in Egaña 1974, previously unnoticed by linguists; the paper compares it with NW-Argentine/Chaco languages to address genetic affiliation.

sources.note: Nothing on Tonocoté stress; pp. XII and XVI say the Tonocoté probably had their own language and that Machoni's Lule=Tonocoté equation was a misunderstanding (identity evidence only). Zamponi's phonology chapter in the same volume concerns Lule (lule1238), not tono1235.
